QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD, and says mutex use is gated behind `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`. It also says ssl_pthread_server needs both macros.
